item.title: Ryanair cabin bag size and allowance
item.description: Will your bag fit Ryanair's cabin limits? Type its size on Willitboard and see in seconds whether it goes at no extra cost, costs extra or doesn't fit. Taken from Ryanair's official page and checked by a person, with the date shown on the page.
